proof_summary: Factor the successive binomial ratios into products over the residues prime to \(p\), expand in elementary symmetric sums of reciprocals, and use residue pairing, power-sum identities, and lifting in \(r\) to bound the harmonic sums and all terms beyond the isolated quadratic main term. Congruences of the lower-level binomial coefficients make that main term’s coefficient gain the remaining powers of \(p\); the case \(p=3\) is handled by stronger pairing and coefficient estimates.
